WITH order_avg AS (
  SELECT
    l_orderkey,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS order_avg_extendedprice
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT
  l.l_orderkey,
  l.l_linenumber,
  l.l_extendedprice,
  oa.order_avg_extendedprice
FROM lineitem l
JOIN order_avg oa ON l.l_orderkey = oa.l_orderkey
WHERE
  l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31'
  AND l.l_extendedprice > oa.order_avg_extendedprice
ORDER BY
  l.l_orderkey ASC,
  l.l_linenumber ASC

SELECT
    c.c_mktsegment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority != '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS other_priority_revenue
FROM customer c
JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY high_priority_revenue DESC, c.c_mktsegment ASC

    total_quantity,

      PARTITION BY n_name

    ) AS supplier_rank
  FROM supplier_qty
)
